posts.title: Craft Log #3: Plastic Toys, Future Ruins
posts.description: I had resin work planned for the evening, but had some free time during the day. So I pulled out the big box of random plastic objects I’ve been hoarding from yard sales and toy sets, looking for anything I could repurpose as terrain for Mordheim. posts.title: Craft Log #2: Garage Sale Loot and Cutting Bricks
posts.description: Today’s session was a mix of things: a yard sale find, a long foam brick cutting session, some online orders, and demolding the silicone mold I poured yesterday. Yard Sale Find I picked up an Angry Birds board game at a yard sale for 1 euro. I don’t care about the game itself, but the plastic pieces inside have real potential for scatter terrain.
